title: Alignment-Preserving Fine-Tuning via Fisher-Guided Decomposition and Riemannian-Geodesic Collision Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the preference for stereotypical responses by contrasting model completions for stereotype-consistent versus stereotype-inconsistent prompts using the CrowS-Pairs benchmark.
Computing the bias gap, which reflects the difference in model accuracy between stereotype-aligned and stereotype-conflicting completions using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset.

Evaluating the model's refusal accuracy and toxicity probability on targeted unsafe prompts designed to elicit hate speech, racist jokes, and offensive stereotypes using the custom DRIFTCHECK and HateCheck datasets.
